text: Aoife starts at the new agency on Monday at 9. She sounded nervous about the commute more than the work. Text her Monday evening to see how the first day went.
Lars is retiring on 14 May after thirty-one years. Leaving do is the Friday before, 6pm at the Crown.
Teresa's daughter Ruby graduates on the 3rd of July. Teresa is already panicking about what to wear.

Call with Yuki Sato this afternoon. Their team lead, Kenji, is leaving at the end of the month and Yuki might be stepping up. Fingers crossed for her. She's been doing half his job for a year anyway, and the clients already go straight to her. She said the decision should come through by the 12th, probably in the afternoon.
Zeynep got the promotion! Senior account manager from 1 November. Must send flowers to her office.
Laila's little boy starts reception on Wednesday morning. She said she'll probably cry more than he will.
Dropped the car off for its MOT. Pick it up tomorrow at half 4.
Tariq mentioned his manager is a nightmare: rewrites every slide and then takes the credit. He's thinking of moving teams in the new year.
Zainab has her driving test on 22/10 at 10:40. She's failed twice already and is properly anxious. Don't forget to text her good luck the night before.
Nikhil and his wife are flying to Lisbon on Thursday for their anniversary. Back on the 28th.

Malik's interview at the council got moved to next Tuesday at 2pm. He's been prepping case studies all week and asked if I'd do a mock interview with him on Sunday evening. It's a panel of three, including the head of housing, and he has to give a ten-minute presentation on tenant engagement first. I said yes.
Esther is vegan now, and her husband Dafydd is gluten free, so plan dinner around that.
Dafydd told me the client meeting on Friday has been cancelled. They're pushing the whole project back to spring.
Zhang's son Chris got into Edinburgh to do medicine! Results came through this morning. Zhang was beaming.
Ask Abdi how his first week went at the hospital. He started as a staff nurse on the 6th.
Jaya said Isaac has been off work with stress since September. She's worried about him but he doesn't want a fuss.
Aditi hinted that she'd love a decent pair of running headphones. Her birthday is 9th of December.

Patrick is being made redundant. The consultation meeting is on Thursday at 11 and he's dreading it. I should ring him afterwards. His wife Esther has only just gone back to work part time after the baby, so the timing is awful. He's already looking at contract roles and asked me to keep an ear out for anything in data analysis.
Zofia's mum retires next Friday. They're throwing a surprise lunch for her on Sunday the 2nd, around 1pm.
Emily got her A level mock results back. Two As and a B, and she was gutted about the B.
Sinead has a dog called Biscuit who chews everything. She's taking him to puppy training on Saturday mornings.
Caroline was in a great mood today. Her team finally signed the Dubois contract after six months of back and forth.

Dawit has a presentation to the board on the 19th at 3pm. First time he's presenting on his own. Wish him luck that morning. He's been rehearsing it on his dog, apparently, and keeps rewriting the opening. His boss, Caroline, will be in the room, which isn't helping. He also mentioned his daughter starts secondary school next week, so it's a busy month.
Lunch with Eamon. He's into sea swimming at the moment and goes in every morning before work, even in October.
Pieter's last day at the firm is 31 October. He's going freelance. Need to chip in for the leaving card and gift by Wednesday.

Adriana and her partner Anya are buying their first flat. Completion is pencilled in for the 15th of November, but the chain is wobbly. Anya is stressed because her landlord wants them out by the 30th either way. Adriana is more relaxed about it. Housewarming will be sometime in December if it all goes through.
Booked my own flu jab for Saturday at 11:20.
Aoife's brother Eamon is graduating from Galway next week. The whole family is going over on Tuesday and coming back Friday night.
Teresa mentioned that her boss, Mrs Haddad, is going on maternity leave in January and nobody knows who will cover. Teresa would like to apply but isn't sure she's ready.
Remember to message Kenji about the reference. He needs it by 5pm on Friday.

Yuki's daughter took her grade 5 piano exam on Saturday. Ask Yuki how it went when I see her tomorrow morning. She'd been practising for months and was terrified of the sight-reading. Results take about three weeks to come through.
Zeynep has a cat called Pickle who has just turned one. She showed me about forty photos.

Laila said the restructure is going ahead. Her whole department moves to the Leeds office from 1 March, and she's not sure she wants to relocate. Her partner works in Manchester, the kids are settled in school, and she's been there eight years. She has until the 30th of November to decide.
Ruby (Teresa's eldest) has started her first proper job at a law firm in town. She's in on Monday at half 8.
Lars told me he's taking up woodturning once he retires. He's already bought a lathe and it's in the garage.
Tariq's sister Zainab passed her driving test! Fourth time lucky.
Quick chat with Nikhil after the stand-up. He's been asked to lead the migration project, which is a big deal for him. Starts properly after half term.
Note to self: renew passport before the end of November.

Malik got the council job! Starts 4 January. He's going to tell his current manager tomorrow at 10, which he's a bit nervous about. His manager, Mr Thomas, has been decent to him and he feels guilty leaving mid-project. I told him a month's notice is plenty. Must take him out for a celebratory pint before Christmas.
Esther's grandson Isaac starts nursery on Monday. She'll be doing the drop-offs on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Dafydd's wife Caroline is having knee surgery on 12 November. He'll be working from home for a fortnight after. I should drop a meal round that week.
Zhang complained that the new finance director keeps scheduling meetings at 8am. Apparently half the team is fuming.
Abdi's twins finished their GCSEs and both got into the sixth form. He's thrilled.
Jaya prefers tea to coffee, hates fuss, and is training for the Cardiff half marathon.
Isaac's back at work on Monday on a phased return, just mornings for the first two weeks. Check in with him on Wednesday to see how he's finding it.

Phone call with Aditi Gupta. She's moving to Bristol for a new role in product design. The move is on the 6th of December and she starts on the 9th. Her sister Anya is helping her pack the weekend before.

Patrick said his son Chris has his first football match for the school team on Saturday at 10. He's playing in goal. Patrick is more nervous than Chris is. His daughter Zofia has her first ballet show the same afternoon at 3, so it's going to be a dash across town. I said I'd come to the match if I'm free.
Zofia Nowak from the Krakow office is visiting on 14/11. She'd like a tour of the warehouse and dinner somewhere Polish-free, her words.
Emily's off to uni in Leeds next September. She wants to study architecture.
Don't forget Sinead's leaving drinks are tomorrow at 5:30. Get a card for her before lunch.
Caroline says the new hire, Pieter, is brilliant with clients but terrible at answering emails.
Dawit's presentation went really well, apparently. The board approved the budget. Send him a congratulations message.
Coffee with Eamon and his girlfriend Adriana. They got engaged in Rome last weekend! Wedding probably summer 2028.
Anya mentioned that her dad, Uncle Lars as everyone calls him, is turning seventy on the 2nd of March. She's thinking of a family dinner.
Pieter Schmidt (Piet to everyone) is our new contact at the supplier. Very direct, likes everything in writing.
Grocery shop, return the parcel, and clean the kitchen before Mum arrives tonight.

Long call with Aoife tonight. Her mum has been diagnosed with early-stage Parkinson's and she's struggling with it, especially being so far away. She's flying home to Cork on the 5th of November for a fortnight and will work remotely. Her manager has been good about it. I need to send her something nice before she goes, and ring her on the 6th once she's settled.
Teresa's son Kenji is sitting his eleven-plus on Saturday the 14th at 9am. He's been revising every evening and the whole house is tense.
Yuki says her husband Patrick has been offered a secondment in Singapore for a year. They haven't decided yet; the kids' schooling is the sticking point. They'll know by Christmas.
I'm taking Zainab to her hospital appointment on Thursday at 2:15. Her scan results should be back the week after.
